parameters.content:
## Path 1: form to first call
Form stands in for the Meta lead form (FORM_SPEC.md). Raw submission is always stored in Twenty (endCustomer). Light gate per D-014: valid US phone, consent ticked, no submission from the same phone in 24 hours. Consent wording is a DRAFT until counsel signs off (task 1.4). Fill the two placeholders in Call Settings (agent ID, caller ID) and attach the Retell credential before any test.

## Path 2: post call webhook
Set this URL as the webhook on the Retell agent. Only call_analyzed is processed. No IP allowlist (n8n Cloud hides the caller IP). Instead the call ID is fetched back from Retell's get-call API with the Retell credential, and only Alex's calls are processed. A forged request cannot produce a real call.

parameters.message: =Hi {{ ($json.name || "there").split(" ")[0] }}, this is Alex with Kynetic Roofing. We just tried calling about your free roof inspection request. Reply here or book a time: https://cal.com/abdullah-kyneticai/roof-inspection. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.

parameters.content:
## DRAFT (disabled): keep-warm SMS
Not connected to any active path. Do not enable until: A2P 10DLC registered sender, form consent covers texts (needs an smsConsent field in Twenty), STOP/HELP handling, form-fill leads only, quiet hours 8:00-21:00 local. No Twilio credential is attached; pick it in the editor at enable time.
